name: assetpanda/page-cards
title: AP Page Cards
description: Card grid for the 2026 company and resource pages: centred eyebrow, heading and intro over 2 to 4 columns of white cards in one of four looks — icon (an SVG icon in a tinted tile that takes the card's brand colour), number (numbered steps joined by a rule), badge (an award or partner badge with a list of links) or plain — each with a title, copy with inline links, optional link list or whole-card link; then optional buttons and small print. Cards rise in on scroll. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
